title: participant_left
description: The facts the message kind participant_left (a student left your class) can use. A fact schema is the one definition of what a template of this kind may mention: the Console offers exactly these as placeholders and the checker refuses any other. Facts marked x_derived are worked out by the kind's fact builder in the product, not typed by anyone and not computed by the template.

x_kind.name: Participant left (a student left your class)
triggers: A student who held a seat (assigned or confirmed) is declined, withdrawn, cancelled or removed from a class (automatic). Every instructor still placed in that class is told.
x_kind.recipient: individual: each instructor placed in the class (primary and secondary).
x_kind.dedupe: explicit key: kind + instructor + attendance id + the placement's status history length (or the removal time)

name.description: How the email greets the instructor: their given name, else their display name, else the word there.

when_day.description: The day in words, in the class's time zone.

when_span.description: The start and end times with the zone abbreviation, in the class's time zone.

when_short.description: A short day and start time for subject lines.

time_zone.description: The class's time zone as an IANA name; America/Denver if none is set. An unknown name shows times in UTC.

venue.description: The venue's name. Absent when none.

room.description: The room label at the venue. Absent when none.

where.description: Venue and room together, joined with a middle dot. Absent when both are absent.
examples: Ozo's Coffee, East Pearl · Back room

address.description: The venue's address on one line. Absent when none.

student_name.description: The display name of the student who left the class.

how.description: What happened, in words: is no longer scheduled, withdrew, declined, was removed. One short phrase that follows the student's name.
